additions.provenance: server_only assessment authoring plan resolver requires an individual Manager development identity and reads one exact training plan by identity-derived hotel_id plus plan revision id

server_only plan scope validation loads the exact same-hotel published Standard referenced by the selected plan; department_manager is then restricted to a Standard targeting exactly its operational department
server_only authoring loader reads one exact draft by identity-derived hotel_id plus authoring_id and allowed status, then revalidates the referenced plan and Standard Manager scope
server_only append-only assessment authoring event uses identity-derived hotel_id, exact authoring_id and actor staff_user_id with composite same-hotel foreign keys
server_only draft creation occurs only after same-hotel plan and published Standard scope validation and inserts identity hotel_id, plan revision id and identified Manager creator

server_only proposal save first reloads the same-hotel Manager-scoped authoring and normalizes assessment content while overriding source plan hash, Standard hash and training unit ids from persisted authority; update is constrained by hotel_id+authoring_id and draft/proposal_ready status

server_only authoring list reads only identity-derived hotel_id; hotel_manager sees the hotel while department_manager rows are filtered by revalidating each referenced plan/Standard operational department scope

server_only human publish preparation reads the latest revision number only for identity-derived hotel_id plus exact assessment_key after proposal_ready Manager-scope validation; DB publish RPC rechecks next revision under advisory lock

server_only service_role_only human publish authority; database locks exact same-hotel proposal_ready assessment authoring, validates proposal hash, active manager identity, plan and published Standard lineage, enforces department_manager scope, compares published assessment payload to stored proposal excluding only revision/hash, verifies source hashes and next revision, then atomically inserts immutable assessment revision and publication audit state
